method: Fresh frame-based review of new04v2 under its frozen particle-free script/audio binding. Read the complete current script and per-scene action/attention context, confirmed actual voice cues and word timings. Opened all 14 chronological pages covering all 270 frames, approved-pair/original/Spring comparison and native samples at 2, 3.5, 4, 5 and 8.966667 seconds. Verified every manifest and clip/reference/endpoint/script/cue/seven-audio hash, measured the actual Arthur WAV and independently decoded 135 exact pairs with framemd5. This is static chronological/native review and measured-cue alignment, not manual listening or real-time final playback. No source, policy, script, cues or user frame approval changed.

reference_match.observed: The actual source retains the approved single cropped hand, same dry twig, charred bough and ember arrangement in the same close view. Sol is absent. The approved twig includes a small lateral cut nub despite the script word unbranched; this is preserved artwork, not a new second twig/tool or generated fork.

eyes.observed: No Sol or other face is visible in any chronological frame; no invisible eye/gaze test is invented.

flame_and_limbs.observed: Sol is absent. His connected-wiggle/particle-free anatomy rule is not imposed on the human hand or rooted wood fire.

framing_and_props.observed: All 14 pages preserve one cropped hand entering from upper-right, one twig and the same ember/bough layout. The fixed close-up keeps tip, grip and support readable; no generated camera movement, new person or extra tool appears.

contacts_and_action.observed: Stable pinched grip lowers the twig into the coals by about 1.3 seconds. The blunt tip and shaft are supported before fingers open around 3.3-3.8 seconds. Native 2/3.5/4-second samples show placement then separation; the twig remains at that position while the hand withdraws once upper-right, leaving by about 5.1 seconds. A contact flame begins around 4 seconds, after supported placement. No regrip, repeated poke or falling/skating released twig was observed.

mechanical_direction.observed: Consecutive source states show the required order: held lowering, contact/support, finger release, one upper-right withdrawal, stationary supported twig and rooted contact fire. Fire does not precede placement, and the released wood does not follow the departing hand.

object_continuity.observed: Same continuous twig, cut nub, bough, coal pieces and ash preserve count/placement. After release the twig is stationary through the tail. Only small upper fire shapes change at the twig/ember base; no migrating fuel/fire or whole-scene brightness pulse is visible. Sol particles are inapplicable because he remains off-screen.

start_end_states.observed: Opening has one gripped twig above existing glowing coals with no flame. Ending has the hand fully out, twig supported on the charred surfaces and a small flame at the twig/ember contact, retaining the supplied camera and coal layout. Generated texture is somewhat sharper than the PNGs; not claimed pixel-identical.

performance_and_timing.observed: Independently decoded 270 frames/135 exact adjacent pairs, zero mismatches, normal 9-second duration at 30 fps/15 source updates. Placement/release/withdrawal is readable in order with stable background, no interpolation/concealing blur or extra gesture. Actual Arthur WAV duration is 7.127541667 seconds at 1x; offset .2 places the complete file at .2-7.327541667 within the 9-second source. Feeding/them/wood word cues are 2.68-3.58 seconds, while the supported twig is held and released; Making fire begins 4.66 seconds after the contact flame starts. The long source tail remains available for the separately requested editorial dead-air trim; no final tight-cut or mixed playback claim.

clean_footage.observed: Every chronological page shows only the planned cropped hand/wood/embers/fire. No text, captions, watermark/logo, extra hand/tool, on-screen speaker or generated audio stream was observed. The source is silent for separately saved dialogue/sound assembly.

painted_art_style.observed: Actual hand, wood, coals and earth share matte layered painted color and paper/pigment texture. Approved-pair/Spring comparison and five native samples show finer enhanced edges and denser etched surface texture than the softer stills, retained as a chosen-Omni limitation. At phone size the scene remains painted 2D with readable contacts, without glossy/clay rendering or a separate smooth-vector element.

script_and_narrator_attention.observed: Read the full frozen script and actual Scene04 context with confirmed source WAV/word cues. Arthur describes feeding existing embers wood, then distinguishes making fire. The source begins with embers/no flame and shows supported placement, release/withdrawal and a small subsequent contact flame, illustrating tending rather than a new ignition method. Actual .2-7.327541667 file extent fits the source; supported hold/release overlaps feeding/them/wood at 2.68-3.58 seconds, and the existing small flame remains during Making fire from 4.66 seconds onward. Sol is absent throughout, so no Narrator listening gaze/idle is required. Audio hashes/duration and automatic word cues were checked; no manual listening or unseen final mixed playback is claimed. Later dead-air/cue trimming needs a fresh binding.

summary: PASS frozen04v2 source/measured-voice review: stable grip, support before release, stationary released twig, one hand exit and rooted fire only after placement. All 270 frames covered; 135 exact pairs verified. Actual Arthur file fits at .2-7.327541667 seconds. Approved small twig cut nub and denser etched paint texture remain explicit limitations.
